title: Heraclides
summary: Raleigh names Heraclides in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Heraclides, who commends the report that the Greekes did not lie before Troy the first nine yeeres. He is not one of the Heraclidae. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIV, §. IV, sig. 281a
